name: What should I prepare before meeting with a contractor about a new kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a contractor about a new kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling a layout consultation, document what currently does not work in your kitchen, such as crowded prep areas, lack of pantry storage, or blocked entryways. Measure the general room perimeter and note the locations of existing windows, doors, and exterior vents. It also helps to list your preferred appliances, including dimensions for any oversized refrigerators or range hoods you plan to install, as appliance sizes dictate cabinet spacing. Having a clear list of daily pain points allows the contractor to propose functional framing and cabinetry adjustments tailored to your lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your kitchen's daily functional problems, note appliance dimensions, and outline whether you want more prep space, seating, or pantry storage before your consultation.
